scripts.db:create-migration: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma migrate dev --create-only'
scripts.db:generate: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma format && bunx prisma generate'
scripts.db:migrate: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.db:reset: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma migrate reset' && bun run db:seed
scripts.db:seed: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma db seed'
scripts.db:studio: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma studio'
scripts.db:validate: bun run toc database 'bunx prisma validate'
